criteria.description: Every new viewer rail is anchored to the P1 pane bound by the selected ledger
Viewer panes stay isolated, preserve focus, and never place a viewer process below P1
Exact reuse, replacement, locking, and concurrent launch behavior remain correct
Manifest selection, workspace isolation, publisher modes, and prior launcher behavior remain compatible
Publisher tests, launcher tests, frontend tests, production build, browser smoke, and diff check pass
